description: Save files locally via the share menu

latest_release.body:
## Changelog

- New notification/foreground service system, including progress reporting and cancel option
- Multi-file saving, including option to save file only specific files
- Option to save to Downloads folder via MediaStore on Android 10+
- Free space checks were added
- Modularization, Android 17 support and i18n and many optimizations

Some new features are experimental and may break.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MateusRodCosta/SaveLocally/compare/v2.1.2a...v2.2.0

## i18n

Please keep submitting translations at https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/save-locally/.
